class.name: SteamItemQuantity
class.brief_description: An owned item instance and positive quantity to exchange.
class.description: Pass these records to [method SteamInventory.craft]. The instance ID is an unsigned decimal string and the quantity is a positive integer of at most [code]4294967295[/code].

method.name: make
method.description: Returns a pair containing [param instance_id] and [param quantity]. [method SteamInventory.craft] validates both fields before submitting an exchange.

method.name: get_instance_id
method.description: Returns the opaque instance ID in unsigned decimal form.

method.name: get_quantity
method.description: Returns the requested positive exchange quantity.

members.member: The opaque instance ID in unsigned decimal form.
